name: Tony Wu
office: City of West Covina, Member of the City Council, 5th District

items.text: Tony Wu represents District 5 on the West Covina City Council. He was first elected in 2015. His campaign says he has balanced the city budget each year and increased reserves from $9 million in 2019 to over $24 million. He supports strengthening public safety and addressing homelessness, and plans to improve city infrastructure. In September 2026, he voted to oppose large-scale data centers and battery storage facilities, citing fire and safety concerns.
